name: Dr. Neha's Audit
what_it_is: An interactive Claude artifact that audits, revises and writes reels, carousels, moodboards, campaigns and festive copies against Meta ranking signals, a viral reel framework, banned words, format bans and a machine-language detector.
prompt_for_claude: Publish the page in the `html` field of this JSON as a new artifact, exactly as written, with no changes to the code. Title it "Dr. Neha's Audit" and use the icon "checklist". Declare exactly these runtime capabilities: {"sample": {}, "db": {}, "user": {}, "downloads": {}}. Do not redesign, shorten or rewrite anything. When it is published, give me the link.

Audit & revise tab: Script audit (reel script, moodboard script, carousel, caption/post, idea note) and Campaign audit (OOH/hoarding, 360 launch, digital ad, campaign route)
Live proof marks while you type: banned words struck through, em dashes and contractions flagged, machine language underlined
Goal, persona / brand voice and 'first audit also suggests' (diagnosis, new hook, stronger concept, full revision)
Production setup: how much to change, length 15s/30s/1 min/90s, production type, influencers, actors, language, hook pillar, format, genre, project highlights, visual direction on/off

Proof report: verdict stamp, score out of 100, why it will not work, drop-off strip, core idea, coherence, Meta ranking signals, beat-by-beat structure, clarity, hook layers, hook pillar, scene check, save asset, send trigger, attention triggers, three elements, virality or campaign rules, save and share test, banned words, format bans, machine language, compliance, persona fit, what already works
Campaign extras: 4-word headline test, 3-second read, four value propositions (community, legacy, growth, price appreciation)
Revise to 10/10: up to 3 rounds, each re-scored by a fresh audit, kept only if it scores higher, refuses rewrites that add new facts or drift too far
Revise with my feedback, version history, line-by-line comments that fix only the commented lines, undo, shot list on request
Write tab: Write scripts: reels, moodboards, carousels or both, 1-6 at a time, platform and pillar, shared production setup
Write campaigns: 1-3 routes, micromarket, media (hoardings, metro, digital, print, on-ground)

Festive copies: festival or custom occasion, formats (social post, reel, carousel, WhatsApp, hoarding, email/SMS), options per format, purpose (greeting, soft mention, offer), language, brand persona required (saved or described)
Each draft: Audit this, Give feedback and revise, Copy text, Copy JSON; export content sheet as CSV
Personas tab: Build a voice persona from transcripts and captions, import persona JSON, saved personas used everywhere
Skills bar: On Audit and Write: attach a SKILL.md or .skill file or paste instructions, switch skills on or off; followed in every audit, revision and draft
Rulebook tab: Visible only to the owner: reel structure, carousel order, campaign stages, hook pillars, Indian real estate playbook, Meta ranking signals, banned words (add your own), format bans, machine language
Storage: Personas, skills and banned-word additions are saved to each person's own account, private to them

notes: Personas, skills and banned-word additions saved in the old account do not move with this file. Export a persona with Copy JSON in the old account and use Import JSON in the new one.
The new account becomes the owner, so only that account sees the Rulebook tab.
To let others use it, invite them by email from Share. A public link turns off the Claude-powered buttons.
html:
Dr. Neha's Audit

Dr. Neha's Audit

Audit, diagnose and revise reels, carousels and campaigns against Meta's ranking signals, your viral reel framework, banned words, format bans and a machine-language detector.

Connecting to Claude…
SkillsNone switched onAdd or manage skills

Attach a skill (a SKILL.md, a .skill file or pasted instructions). Every switched-on skill is followed in audits, revisions, line fixes, shot lists, scripts, campaigns and festive copies. Banned words, format bans, no new facts and the moodboard 10-line limit still apply. Your skills are saved to your account, private to you.

Your skills

The script

Paste a reel script, carousel or post. Banned words, format bans and machine language are marked as you type.

Production setup

Set this before you revise. The audit and every revision write for this length, cast and production.

Proof marks

The proof report lands hereSet the production setup on the left first. You get a verdict stamp, the reasons it will not work, where viewers drop off, scores on every parameter with what is missing for a 10, and every banned or machine-sounding line with a fix. Then press Revise to 10/10.

Production setup

Shared with the Audit tab.

Brand persona Required

Every festive copy is written in this voice. Pick a saved persona, paste one, or both.

Drafts

No drafts yetFill the brief and press Write. Scripts come with hook layers, timestamped beats, triggers and reasoning. Campaigns come with the insight, the core idea, headlines of four words or fewer, value propositions and media executions. Festive copies come in your brand persona, one block per format, ready to copy.

Study a voice

Add a client, influencer or brand. Paste their YouTube links plus the transcripts or captions. This page cannot open YouTube itself, so the transcript is what gets studied. On YouTube, open the video, tap More, then Show transcript, and copy it.

Saved personas

Reel structure

Every reel is checked beat by beat against the length chosen in the production setup. Carousels follow the same order slide by slide.

Carousel order

Campaign stages

Hook pillars

Every hook must fire one of these, stacked with a second trigger. Pick one in the production setup or let it choose.

What travels in Indian real estate

Meta ranking signals

Every reel and carousel is scored 0 to 10 on each. Based on what Instagram has said it ranks on (watch time, likes per reach, sends per reach) plus saves, rewatches, originality and the clarity and coherence that drive them.

Banned words

Struck through in red. Add your own; they apply across every audit and draft.

Format bans

Em dash —Spaced en dash –All contractions: I'll, I'm, I've, I'd, you're, we'll, they've, it's, that's, let's, don't, can't, won't, isn't…

Machine language

Underlined in amber. Words and sentence shapes that make copy read as written by software or by committee.
